title: Wire up 'ask-from-floating-button' event to ChatInterface
body: The FloatingAskButton dispatches a 'ask-from-floating-button' custom event on submit, but ChatInterface does not yet listen for this event. Need to add a window event listener in ChatInterface to handle this event and inject the question into the chat.
rationale: Without this wiring, the floating button submission has no effect on the chat.

title: Test button in fullscreen mode
body: Verify the floating button persists and moves to center when Prev/Next navigation appears at 85% scroll. The isCentered prop is wired, but end-to-end testing is needed.
rationale: Issue requirement states button must persist in fullscreen mode.
